# Security policy

## Supported versions

This project is young. Security fixes are applied on the latest release on the default branch when practical.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security-sensitive reports.

Email the maintainer privately (via the address on your GitHub profile), or use GitHub **Private vulnerability reporting** if enabled on the repository.

Include:

- Description of the issue
- Steps to reproduce
- Impact (e.g. unexpected elevation, local file overwrite, etc.)

You should receive an acknowledgment when the report is seen. Please allow reasonable time before any public disclosure.
